list.name: Backend Service
list.description: The authoritative backend.py entry point starts tray or headless operation, while versioned UDP RPC and MotorService manage ownership, asynchronous runs, feedback, and watchdog shutdown using APS by default or explicitly injected legacy controllers.

list.name: Hardware And Shared Control
list.description: ADLINK APS bindings own PCIe-8332 motion and endpoint protection, while shared hardware-independent device types, locking, validation, and motion queues support both current and legacy controllers.

list.name: Portable UDP Client
list.description: The independent UdpControl package supplies the standard-library SDK, JSON codecs, protocol version, Tk debug panel, GUI entry point, and command-line motion example without hardware imports.

list.name: Legacy Direct EtherCAT
list.description: Retained pysoem direct-NIC controllers, continuous local sessions, CLI, and app.py Tk frontend implement discovery and CiA402 motion alongside the older three-axis bridge host.

list.name: Legacy Unreal Integration
list.description: The Unreal Blueprint component and Python demo stream motor-angle targets through the retained three-axis bridge protocol, which is incompatible with the current versioned UDP RPC backend.

list.name: Regression Tests
list.description: Fake-hardware, GUI, protocol, deployment-isolation, and loopback UDP regressions verify APS and legacy motion, ordering, watchdogs, cleanup, endpoint feedback, retries, and portable-client integration.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project, backend, portable-client, and legacy integration guides document installation, operating procedures, protocol contracts, and dependency requirements for the distinct controller paths.

list.name: Configuration And Launchers
list.description: Example endpoint and APS settings plus Windows command launchers configure server/client deployment, start tray or console processes, and install backend dependencies.

file:app.py.name: app.py
file:app.py.summary: Legacy Tk desktop frontend for direct-NIC pysoem control, device selection, dry runs, single moves, and persistent manual target updates. A single worker owns EtherCAT while queued events update the interface and cooperative stop controls cleanup.

file:cli.py.name: cli.py
file:cli.py.summary: Optional legacy command-line frontend that scans a dedicated EtherCAT adapter and selects motors by unique drive aliases. It verifies communication without enabling by default; --run requests a bounded relative move.

file:continuous_control.py.name: continuous_control.py
file:continuous_control.py.summary: Legacy persistent local PP controller extending core._Session with a latest-target queue, immediate updates during motion, and encoder rollover tracking. It holds enabled axes while idle and closes command submission before restoring hardware parameters.

file:core.py.name: core.py
file:core.py.summary: Legacy direct-NIC pysoem controller for discovery and validated CiA402 profile-position motion. Sessions verify drive identity, PDO/DC/watchdog settings, exchange cyclic feedback with bounded recovery, and disable drives before restoring temporary parameters.

file:platform_control.py.name: platform_control.py
file:platform_control.py.summary: Legacy UDP bridge for three motor-angle targets and a persistent pysoem session, using hello/state and session/seq/enable/targets_deg messages. This older UE protocol is incompatible with the current versioned UDPServer API.

file:test_app_continuous.py.name: test_app_continuous.py
file:test_app_continuous.py.summary: Tk flow regressions using the real local continuous session with an emulated EtherCAT master. They cover target editing, relative updates, live sliders, cancellation, single-move compatibility, and disabling after stop.

file:test_continuous_control.py.name: test_continuous_control.py
file:test_continuous_control.py.summary: Hardware-free regressions for local latest-target queues and legacy EtherCAT sessions. They exercise numeric validation, bounded PDO recovery, immediate retargeting, idle enable, cleanup, and accumulated travel across encoder rollovers.

file:test_platform_control.py.name: test_platform_control.py
file:test_platform_control.py.summary: Shared fake EtherCAT slave/master and hardware-free regressions for the legacy three-axis UDP bridge and CiA402 session. Tests cover peer ownership, sequence validation, latched disable, watchdog faults, position wrapping, and parameter restoration.

file:UdpControl/__main__.py.name: __main__.py
file:UdpControl/__main__.py.summary: Launches the independent Tk UDP control client with endpoint configuration, command-line overrides, rotating logs, and UI-thread cleanup. It imports no controller or hardware library.

file:UdpControl/client.py.name: client.py
file:UdpControl/client.py.summary: Implements the standard-library-only, thread-safe UDP motor SDK with retried ACK requests, owner sessions, per-run targets, independent heartbeats, and telemetry ordering. Separates request IDs, control_seq, shared target/heartbeat seq, run_id, and state_serial/server_id.

file:UdpControl/debug_ui.py.name: debug_ui.py
file:UdpControl/debug_ui.py.summary: Provides a Tk debug panel that selects devices, scans the controller, enables runs, streams coalesced slider targets, and displays axis and endpoint-limit feedback through the UDP SDK. A dedicated executor submits stop requests independently of ordinary ACK waits.

file:UdpControl/example_client.py.name: example_client.py
file:UdpControl/example_client.py.summary: Offers a command-line SDK example that queries status by default and uses --move to scan, enable selected axes, and send sinusoidal offsets at approximately 60 Hz. It disables the run in a finally block.

file:UdpControl/wire.py.name: wire.py
file:UdpControl/wire.py.summary: Provides compact UTF-8 JSON encoding and strict datagram decoding for portable clients. Decoding rejects oversized packets, non-object JSON, and non-finite constants; the SDK currently uses encode and handles received JSON itself.

file:test_udp_protocol.py.name: test_udp_protocol.py
file:test_udp_protocol.py.summary: Verifies UDP request deduplication, control-sequence replay protection, ownership and authentication, run isolation, leases, malformed packets, lost-ACK retries, and server-restart feedback filtering. Uses a mocked motor service and loopback sockets.

file:test_udp_service.py.name: test_udp_service.py
file:test_udp_service.py.summary: Exercises the UDP SDK, server, and motor service together with an injected fake EtherCAT controller. Covers selected-axis runs, unlimited offsets, heartbeat watchdogs, independent target ordering, fault recovery, and a portable client subprocess.

file:aps_backend.py.name: aps_backend.py
file:aps_backend.py.summary: Owns the ADLINK PCIe-8332 APS DLL lifecycle and validates SV635N topology, units, direction and endpoint sensors. Runs card-generated point-to-point motion with preflight checks, continuous feedback, directional limit escape, and verified stop/disable/parameter restoration.

file:backend.py.name: backend.py
file:backend.py.summary: Starts the Windows tray or headless UDP backend, validates configuration and records rotating logs. Creates MotorService and UDPServer, launches the control UI in a separate process, and closes the server and hardware owner on exit.

file:control_common.py.name: control_common.py
file:control_common.py.summary: Defines hardware-independent device, motion profile, command and error types. Coordinates cross-process hardware exclusivity and a locked latest-target queue whose relative intent accumulates while pending commands are replaced.

file:motor_service.py.name: motor_service.py
file:motor_service.py.summary: Coordinates asynchronous scan and enable lifecycles, immutable status snapshots and run-scoped sequenced targets/heartbeats. A single-worker executor owns hardware access, while a watchdog requests stops and schedules idle sensor reads; failures latch until an explicit scan. Injected controllers can use the legacy direct-NIC fallback through lazy imports.

file:test_aps_backend.py.name: test_aps_backend.py
file:test_aps_backend.py.summary: Exercises APS ABI bindings, configuration, topology and motion using a fake API with injected faults and sensor changes. Tests directional endpoint protection, stop/disable/restoration and real UDP integration, including proof that APS access stays on one hardware thread.

file:test_udp_ui.py.name: test_udp_ui.py
file:test_udp_ui.py.summary: Tests the Tk UDP frontend against injected legacy hardware and a local server. Verifies selection, hidden-window heartbeats, isolated tray client launch and endpoint displays that distinguish trigger, conflict, unavailable and stale feedback.

file:udp_server.py.name: udp_server.py
file:udp_server.py.summary: Implements versioned UDP JSON RPC with exclusive session leases, authentication, request deduplication and monotonic control sequencing. Routes requests to MotorService, publishes snapshots, and requests a stop when the socket worker fails or the server closes.
